\textit{Note.} Error magnitude = hypot(along, cross) at each time after the flow-loss point; UKF and FGO baselines (no heading), 11 flights each (blank floor: the standard-sensor dataset, the camera calibration flights and both camera datasets). \textdagger{} runaway magnitudes: evidence of divergence with its order of magnitude, not bit-reproducible values.\par
\textit{Note.} EKF3 'invalid': on all 14 blank flights there are 0 valid airborne flow frames in the cruise, so flow aiding never starts; EKF3 flags its position invalid from take-off (301--310 s of cruise) and outputs exactly the origin, which is not scored (evaluation rule).
